ns2:section.sectionText: 3 hours Meets with ITAL 510 and SPAN 461, G4. This section for advanced Spanish undergraduate students only with the consent of the instructor. It will not count toward fulfillment of the graduation requirements for the undergraduate major in Spanish. Taught in English. Students must meet the prerequisite requirements for this course (found in the Catalog Entry) or will be told to drop on the first day of classes.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Teaching of Spanish or Spanish major(s). Restricted to students with Senior class standing. Restricted to Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign.
